versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the go-doc-comments skill.
- Provides guidance for writing Go source comments conforming to the official [go.dev/doc/comment](https://go.dev/doc/comment) standard.
- Covers when to comment, identifier-first sentences, godoc syntax, formatting, and language matching.
- Explains clear rules for placement, style, syntax, and documentation of exported declarations.
- Includes structured decision framework for whether and how to comment, with practical examples.
